rubric_mapping.schema_valid: deployed scan path (recorded Tesseract OCR replay -> field map -> typed extraction -> supervisor) output parses with the Zod LabResult/IntakeForm/Citation schemas and the HTTP response validator; the validator rejects outputs missing required keys or with malformed citations
rubric_mapping.citation_present: every fact, typed lab result, intake field and handoff citation has the 5 keys, cites the stored document id, quotes text verbatim from the recorded OCR (or text source) that contains the cited value, and its bounding box is the quoted OCR line inside the page; facts from OCR lines below 0.85 confidence (and only those) carry the review flag; guideline evidence carries guideline citations
rubric_mapping.factually_consistent: typed values, units, ranges, collection dates, abnormal flags and intake fields equal hand-written truth files; each LabResult cites its value line and its confidence is the minimum of its source OCR lines; guideline retrieval for the abnormal finding or chief concern ranks the relevant chunk first
rubric_mapping.safe_refusal: zero fields, blank page, doc-type mismatch, patient mismatch (intake name, intake DOB, lab report header), no chart record, cross-patient read, off-topic questions and corrupt PDFs are BLOCKED, QUALIFIED or refused; never READY
rubric_mapping.no_phi_in_logs: real workflow traces (InMemoryTraceSink) and captured stdout/stderr contain none of the truth-file identifiers (name, DOB, phone, medications, allergies, lab values, collection dates); raw handoffs stay redacted by the trace redactor

cases.label: schema_valid
cases.guards_against: Zod LabResult parsing or the HTTP response validator rejects or drops the typed results of a clean vector lab PDF.

cases.label: schema_valid
cases.guards_against: IntakeForm parsing fails, or a field the form contains is reported not_found_on_form.

cases.label: schema_valid
cases.guards_against: Alternate intake labels (Name/DOB/Telephone/Allergy) stop mapping into a valid IntakeForm.

cases.label: schema_valid
cases.guards_against: Single-letter H/L flags produce a value outside the AbnormalFlag enum and invalidate the result.

cases.label: schema_valid
cases.guards_against: A noisy image-only scan yields a malformed or fabricated LabResult instead of typing only the complete test and reporting the rest as a typed issue.

cases.label: schema_valid
cases.guards_against: The LabResult contract stops requiring a field (e.g. reference_range) so the HTTP boundary would forward an incomplete lab result.

cases.label: schema_valid
cases.guards_against: The IntakeForm contract stops requiring demographics, chief concern, medications, allergies or family history.

cases.label: schema_valid
cases.guards_against: The citation contract stops validating bounding_box or accepts a citation missing one of the five keys or carrying an extra key.

cases.label: schema_valid
cases.guards_against: Zod LabResult parsing or the HTTP response validator rejects or drops the typed results extracted from a `.scan.txt` text-envelope lab upload — the only non-PDF path left once the legacy LAB| format and /lab-evidence route are retired. The envelope has no printed patient header, so it must stay QUALIFIED patient_identity_unverified — never BLOCKED patient_mismatch by reading a "test name:" field label as the patient name.

cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: A vector-PDF lab fact or typed result loses a citation key, cites the wrong document or the wrong line (e.g. the test-name line instead of the value line), quotes text not in the OCR, or points outside the page.

cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: An observed intake field (demographics, meds, allergies, history) is emitted without a complete, verbatim citation.

cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: Rasterized intake fields lose their page region or verbatim quote.

cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: Facts read from low-confidence OCR lines lose their human-review flag (so the preview would call them verified), or are cited with a reconstructed label instead of the verbatim OCR text. S6: the same low-confidence values must also never surface as a grounded-answer patient_fact claim.

cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: Facts from a partially read noisy scan are emitted uncited or with a box outside the page.

cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: Facts from a document whose declared type is contradicted are shown without source provenance.

cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: Guideline evidence reaches the workflow without the five-key guideline citation.

cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: A `.scan.txt` lab fact or typed result loses a citation key, quotes text not in the envelope, or points outside the page — the citation defect the retired LAB| path could hide.

cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: An observed `.scan.txt` intake field loses its quote or page — the citation defect the retired INTAKE| path could hide.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: Value, unit, reference range, collection date, abnormal flag or confidence (min of its source lines) of a clean lab PDF no longer matches the document. S6: the grounded answer built from these same facts must have every claim cited with the 5-key contract, and patient-record claims must never appear in the guideline section or vice versa.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: Values read from a rasterized lab PDF drift from the document (e.g. "Hgb" labels or a Yes flag mis-mapped).

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: H and L flags collapse to normal/abnormal or are swapped.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: A noisy scan produces a wrong value, or an A1C result is invented from the fields OCR could not read.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: Intake demographics, chief concern, medications, allergies or family history no longer match the form. S6: every observed intake leaf must also survive independently in the grounded answer as a cited patient_fact claim (the deterministic intake template).

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: Alternate intake labels map values into the wrong typed fields.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: The patient-identity check rejects a form whose demographics do match the chart, or its values drift.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: Guideline retrieval for an abnormal A1C question returns nothing, an irrelevant top chunk, or unranked evidence. S6 (model path): a fake model composer that returns one invented, uncited-in-substance claim and one claim with no citation at all must have both dropped and counted, never shipped (the independent claim judge in this gate fails the case if the uncited claim ships).

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: Retrieval for the intake chief concern (fatigue) ranks an unrelated chunk first.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: Retrieval for medication reconciliation of the intake list ranks an unrelated chunk first.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: Query formulation stops building the query from the document's own typed abnormal lab findings (e.g. the abnormal-findings phrase is dropped), so a request with no clinician message at all finds no evidence even though the document has a real abnormal A1C.

cases.label: safe_refusal
cases.guards_against: A lab layout the OCR label map cannot read is reported READY (or guessed) instead of BLOCKED no_fields_extracted.

cases.label: safe_refusal
cases.guards_against: A blank upload with zero OCR lines proceeds to retrieval as if it were evidence.

cases.label: safe_refusal
cases.guards_against: An intake form uploaded as a lab report is not refused and its type contradiction is not surfaced.

cases.label: safe_refusal
cases.guards_against: A lab report uploaded as an intake form (header name/DOB readable) is reported READY instead of QUALIFIED doc_type_mismatch.

cases.label: safe_refusal
cases.guards_against: An intake form for another patient is attached to this chart instead of BLOCKED patient_mismatch.

cases.label: safe_refusal
cases.guards_against: A clinician scoped to one patient runs the scan workflow on another patient's document (the handler must answer 403).

cases.label: safe_refusal
cases.guards_against: An off-topic question gets guideline evidence or a READY state on the scan path. S6: an off-topic question must also never produce a guideline claim in the grounded answer.

cases.label: safe_refusal
cases.guards_against: A corrupt PDF crashes the request (HTTP 500) or produces a result instead of a structured BLOCKED document_unreadable refusal (HTTP 422).

cases.label: safe_refusal
cases.guards_against: An intake form with this patient's name but a different date of birth is attached to the chart because only the name is compared.

cases.label: safe_refusal
cases.guards_against: A patient with no chart demographics is treated as an identity match, so an unverifiable intake form is reported READY.

cases.label: safe_refusal
cases.guards_against: A lab report whose printed patient header names a different patient is attached to this chart instead of BLOCKED patient_mismatch.

cases.label: safe_refusal
cases.guards_against: A `.scan.txt` lab upload declared as an intake form is reported READY instead of BLOCKED extraction_contract_invalid — the retired LAB|-declared-as-intake defect (sr-10) this refactor must still catch on the surviving scan path.

cases.label: no_phi_in_logs
cases.guards_against: Lab values, collection dates or the report header (name/DOB) reach the stored trace or stdout/stderr on the vector lab path.

cases.label: no_phi_in_logs
cases.guards_against: Intake demographics, medications or allergies reach the trace or console.

cases.label: no_phi_in_logs
cases.guards_against: Rasterized intake OCR text reaches the trace or console.

cases.label: no_phi_in_logs
cases.guards_against: The blocked patient-mismatch path logs the other patient's identifiers.

cases.label: no_phi_in_logs
cases.guards_against: Low-confidence or flagged lab values are logged for debugging.

cases.label: no_phi_in_logs
cases.guards_against: A partially read scan logs its raw OCR lines.

cases.label: no_phi_in_logs
cases.guards_against: The unreadable-document refusal path writes document bytes or tool stderr into the trace or console.

cases.label: no_phi_in_logs
cases.guards_against: The trace redactor stops stripping value/quote-keyed content, so any raw worker handoff recorded in a trace would leak intake identifiers.

cases.label: no_phi_in_logs
cases.guards_against: A `.scan.txt` (non-PDF) lab upload's typed LabResult fields (test_name, unit, reference_range, collection_date, abnormal_flag — the keys the L0 leak showed the redactor's key-based allowlist misses) reach the trace or console — the leak the retired /v1/supervisor text path could hide.
